Montréal Communique 


Friday, November 27, 1970 
For release at will 


Ross Bannerman, 43, has been appointed General 
Secretary of the Montreal YMCA, one of the top Y 
staff posts in Canada. 

His predecessor, Rix G. Rogers, will serve as 
Assistant to the President in Montreal until April Ist, 
1971, when he takes over as General Secretary of the 
National Council of Canadian YMCAs. 

In his new position, effective December Ist, 
Bannerman will be responsible for implementing policy 
and planning a wide mange of programs for the Y in 
Greater Montreal. 

Operating with an annual budget of over 
$3,000,000, he will oversee city-wide activities 
which involve over 55,000 people and, including part- 


time help, an island-spanning staff of over 800. 


-30- 


For further information please call: Bill Sher 
849-5331
